description: Search articles and video across entitled publisher catalogs. Returns matching items with metadata and optional full article text. Omit the publishers parameter to search all entitled publishers. Counts against search quota; may meter first full-article deliveries.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response next_cursor. Continues within the top-100 candidate window.

filters.description: Optional metadata filters. Fields: category, categories, language, sentiment, media_type, has_image, has_video, has_audio, length_words, length_chars, duration_seconds, publish_date_ts, keywords, entities, video_labels, video_face_cues, video_celebrities, video_text, video_moderation_labels. Operators: $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $exists, $and, $or. Example: {"category": "sports", "has_video": true}.

full_article.description: Include full article contents in results. Default: True.

full_article_format.description: Format for full article content: 'html' (default) or 'markdown'. Used only when full_article is true.

limit.description: Page size (max 100). Default: 10. Results ordered by closest match first (lowest cosine distance).

publishers.description: Optional array of lowercase publisher identifiers to narrow the search (e.g. adweek, billboard). Omit to search all entitled publishers.

query.description: Semantic search query to find relevant articles. Supports natural language queries (e.g., 'Taylor Swift', 'NFL playoffs', 'climate change policy')

query_vector.description: Optional precomputed embedding vector. If provided, retrieval uses this vector directly instead of generating one from query.

recent.description: Recent mode: {since_ts: epoch seconds, take: int} or {days_back: int, take: int}. If both are provided, since_ts takes precedence.

return_transcripts.description: Include transcripts and durations in results

return_vectors.description: Include vector embeddings in results (Paid feature)

threshold.description: Cosine distance cutoff. Keep results with distance less than or equal to this value (lower distance = closer match). Lower values = stricter (fewer results). Default: 1.0 (returns most matches).

name: search
title: Search articles and video
